card.title: A New Battery Electrolyte Improves Cycle Retention
card.main_findings: Capacity retention improved by 12% over the baseline electrolyte after 500 cycles.
card.limitations: Lab-scale cells; not validated in commercial battery packs.

ledger.claim: The new electrolyte improved capacity retention by 12% after 500 cycles.
